reviews.title: Cheats
reviews.text: Deleted the app before free trial ended and canceled subscription. 3 days after it was canceled I got charged for a year. Cant use my App Store now because it’s stuck in limbo and Apple won’t do anything to help get rid of the fraud charge that isn’t going through since it was cancelled and my card was removed from it to charge.

reviews.title: Incredibly misleading and unreasonable
reviews.text: When subscribing for a monthly $5 fee, you will be charged $60 up front and forced to pay for the year in full. This is incredibly misleading and the developers and Apple are both unwilling to help. Also, the app isn’t really designed well and it’s incredibly complicated when you first use it. Some features seem to not be ready to use too. This may lead to you needing to access important things like your bank account, maps/navigation, calculator etc and totally locked out without an easy way to get access when you need it quickly. The app unfortunately has done the complete opposite of what it preaches for me. Such a shame that they have been unwilling to switch my annual to a monthly payment like I originally signed up for. Hope someone will eventually be able to make this right.

reviews.title: costs money, it's a scam
reviews.text: yeah so imagine my surprise when a glorified screentime limit app goes through the trouble of making you set up before hitting you with the "start free 3 day trial, then $5/month" like seriously? 3 days? 5 bucks a month for a screentime limit subscription? don't waste your time and just use the built in apple screen limit settings and try to be more disciplined with it I guess.

reviews.title: Lied about “free” trial
reviews.text: I had no issues with the app itself, but did not intend on purchasing a paid subscription. The app was supposed to give me notice 2 days before my trial ended and I never received any notice. I was just charged $60 for a full subscription and Apple denied my refund request. Horrible, deceptive, and predatory subscription system.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I deleted my account before the trial period was up. I liked the app, but couldn’t afford it. They took the payment anyway. Cannot get a response from support to get it back.

reviews.title: Charged me without warning
reviews.text:
The app itself is great and it’s honestly one of the best apps for managing doom scrolling and keeping me off my phone. 

Here is my major issue that made me delete it: When I downloaded the app, it let me do the 14 day trial before I decide to purchase a subscription. It’s not a monthly subscription though, it’s annual. It asked me “Would you like a reminder when the trial will end?” I said YES, remind me TWO days before it ends. I never received that reminder and it charged my card $65 out of the blue. I don’t write reviews like this often because I genuinely love the app and how it functions but I can’t afford a $65 annual subscription right now as a broke college student :/ 
If you have the money, I 100% recommend but I’m disappointed by the lack of transparency and charging my card without notice after it asked if I wanted to be reminded.

reviews.title: A real shame
reviews.text: This app seemed really cool and I would’ve loved to use it!  In the front screen, where you pick your most distracting app, it wouldn’t let me pick an app.  I pressed the arrows on the categories and the arrow would go down, but no apps show up underneath.  So, I can’t even move on in the app.  It also told me it would notify me before my subscription was up, and it didn’t, so now I’ve been charged and I can’t afford it.  I don’t usually give bad reviews, but this was unbelievably bad.  I really wanted to try this app too.

reviews.title: Dishonest company
reviews.text: The app works okay, but they say within it that if you make a video to their specifications and submit they will pay you just for making it. Months after doing so I have not made money and they do not reply to support emails. I wouldn’t support a company so dishonest if I were yall

reviews.title: Charged After Unsubscribing: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I unsubscribed, but this app still charged me for an entire year! I’ve tried contacting customer service multiple times, but received no proper assistance. Extremely disappointing experience and terrible customer service. I would strongly recommend avoiding this app. Be careful before downloading or subscribing!

reviews.title: Charged Credit Card Without Warning
reviews.text: Never warned prior to charging credit card. Ironically now have to spend more screen time fighting with the credit card company.

reviews.title: Don't download this app
reviews.text: When you figure out this app isn't what you thought it was you won't be able to delete it

reviews.title: Worst App ever
reviews.text: I’d give it a zero if I could. Too confusing to stop an active blocking session. I had it set to “all” apps and had an emergency to get to the hospital, was panicked when it took over my map, and I couldn’t see my route. I’ve just moved here and didn’t know where I was going and actually had to pull over, never could figure it out and my passenger had to use their phone map! I contacted support later, and their response was “we can confirm your subscription has been cancelled” and here’s a link to help you block a session. But didn’t clarify that if I deleted it before my trial was over, that it wouldn’t be harder to remove the app, because there IS a warning not to delete the app. I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS APP BASED ON JUST THE WARNING OF DO NOT REMOVE THE APP, and because support clearly didn’t understand how invasive it was during an emergency. Do not download and accept the trial!

reviews.title: No text reminder
reviews.text: I was told I would receive a text reminder or cancel my free trial and never received one and was charged 60 dollars for an whole year. I tried multiple times to get a refund to no avail I would be very careful if you have a free trial with this app and send a reminder into your phone because it DOES NOT send a reminder when to cancel and you will also be out 60 dollars

reviews.title: Liars
reviews.text: It tells you that it will give you a warning to cancel before the trial period but they do not and they also do not respond to email.

reviews.title: Free?
reviews.text: I wish this was free… I had it before and did not pay, maybe it was a free trial… I know you need to make money the price of FB & IG is free… even charging less then $5.00 would be better.

reviews.title: It’s good but…
reviews.text: Overall this app is good, it allows you to block apps to keep you focused and it’s gamified so there is a leaderboard. You even get XP and coins. 100 XP=1 coin, but this is where I don’t like it. I went to redeem my coins for 3 free books and 30 days free of audiobooks.com after working hard to get the coins. I go to the website and… that’s what you get for signing up anyways. It made me loose motivation when there wasn’t the rewards I was promised. I signed up anyways to see if I would get an additional 3 books and 30 days but nope. I also looked at ra optics to see if that was also a scam, it promises 10% off. For this month (October 2026) on the website you get 20% off anyways. I wasn’t expecting the rewards when I got this app, so I didn’t just get it for the rewards but it sucks that they aren’t real rewards.

reviews.title: Free trial not long enough
reviews.text: I would potentially pay for this but having only a free 3 day trial for $60 subscription isn’t long enough to see if I’ll actually use this. It’s a great idea though. Also it should be cheaper. More people would definitely subscribe.

reviews.title: Below-Average App, Zero Customer Support
reviews.text: Nothing original about this app. I cancelled my free trial and they still charged me 63 dollars. Their contract email is a black hole no one responds. Screen Zen is a much better free option. Plus all other apps I have tried had much better refunding policies

reviews.title: Pay only
reviews.text: I’m disappointed that it’s entirely a paid app. Paying a subscription to not use a device I also pay for feels crazy. I’m sure it has promise but I’m personally not interested in the subscription model. I’ll stick with the built in features of my phone instead.

reviews.title: Free trail scam
reviews.text: They say they’ll remind you close to when the free trail is almost over but they do not. I would not recommend purchasing this. Who knows what else they’re lying about. Highly disappointed

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text:
I don’t know why I thought this app would be different than any of the others. There’s always a subscription never a one time purchase. I get the developers need to make a profit off of this but why subscriptions? I’ve read several reviews and they say there’s a free version but you have to sign up for the free trial either way. I’m assuming they just hope you forget about it and charge you. App just seemed like a scam and money grab. The idea was good just made by the wrong people. The ads make the developers sound like they want to help you when it’s just greed.

Update - I got the free trial to check it out and get this. They charged me 10 dollars just to get the “free trial.” I guess that’s on my own incompetence. Should’ve expected it from an app like this. The developers need to do better. Back to what I said they act like they want to help people when all they want is money.

reviews.title: Intentionally very hard to cancel
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to cancel the app, and and the creators have made this very complicated. Instead of being able to simply cancel the subscription with the app itself, like most apps, Be Present is requiring me to log into Stripe. I don’t have login info for Stripe, so I’m not sure what the next step is. Contacted Be Present customer service and am still waiting for a reply. Might need to contact my credit card company to block future charges if I’m not able to cancel. Annoying!

reviews.title: App like this should be banned
reviews.text: It says free app in the App Store, but you can’t even access the app without entering your card details and then pay £40 a year. Not even monthly option. Scam

reviews.title: Usual subscription scam
reviews.text: Not a great app. Somewhat irritating. Might be of use for younger people. Beware when signing up. They promise a subscription reminder email two days before the 7 day trial ends. It never arrives. Apple automatically renew. The developers don’t care - direct you to Apple. Apple don’t care - no refund given.

reviews.title: Does not let you know when subscription renews
reviews.text: No email before , just money taken. Be careful if you do a free trial.

reviews.title: Would be great if it worked!
reviews.text: I love the idea of this and for the one app I’m able to block it world great but I get an error message when I try to look at any categories other than social and the search doesn’t work. Developers are obviously aware of the issue as a message pops up and mentions other category but none of them work for me. Such a shame!

reviews.title: Scam - Fake Free Trial
reviews.text: The title says “1 week free trial” but I was immediately charged £39.99 and Apple refused my refund request so I’m stuck with a 1 year subscription when I thought I was trialling it for 1 week.

reviews.title: Less effective than it was
reviews.text:
I thought this was a great app when I installed it nearly a year ago, but I quickly found ways around the restrictions. You can change your intentions there and then, which allows you to reopen the app.

At night, when all the apps are supposed to be shut down, there’s a ‘Take a Break’ option that you can use endlessly to keep accessing them.

This makes it almost worse than useless. It’s the app equivalent of liquidising Mars bars when you’ve got a gastric band!

I’m ashamed to say I’m addicted to games on my phone. This app initially helped me get that time back, but now it doesn’t. It needs to be much stricter. When my subscription comes up for renewal, I’ll be looking for something better.

reviews.title: PAID SUBSCIPTION.
reviews.text:
Be very careful, this asks a few questions and asks a few permissions, posing as something nice, once you have given your age, gender and given permission to let it monitor your usage, it then slaps you with “ hahaha you idiot, you fell for a Facebook advert scam, this app is only free for a week, subscribe here you foolish loser”
Another scummy move to make you trust even less.

reviews.title: Flawed & irritating
reviews.text:
First, if you want to bypass the entire app it’s only a click away. 

Second, like a lot of people I use my phone for business, exercise & navigation so needed to exclude several categories & only really wanted to exclude social media. 
When I tried to exclude the categories that I need I was told “only 2 categories can be excluded”.

The UI is also clunky - try excluding multiple apps simultaneously and you’ll find out why.

reviews.title: Takes data before forcing subscription
reviews.text: Nowhere on the app does it mention a subscription until AFTER it accesses your data. No doubt they can monetise this data after misleading you.

reviews.title: Free trial impossible to cancel
reviews.text: When you sign-up for a free trial they make it so it is very hard to cancel. Be warned!

reviews.title: Cancelled before the trial ran out but still got charged for the annual sub.
reviews.text:
I liked the app, it was a little dodgy for me though, sometimes the wrong apps would be unlocked and the ones I wanted locked weren’t locked.. which was weird. So wasn’t thrilled at first. As soon as I get a trial on anything I cancel the recurring trial asap though, which is what I did for this app. But I’ve just discovered I still got charged for it. Apple are refusing a refund so I’m hoping this review will mean I can get a refund from the makers of the app themselves, because I don’t want the app, I don’t use the app, so why the hell did I get charged when I cancelled the free trial from recurring anyway??? 

🤦‍♀️🤦‍♀️🤦‍♀️

reviews.title: charged me no reason
reviews.text: I wanted to cancel the subscription however it did not let me and charged me anyway and did not give any notification prior to the charge like was mentioned would happen on the app. App itself too was laggy and sent notifications about focuses i wasn’t in, in the middle of the night

reviews.title: Too many steps to set up
reviews.text:
I just signed up and I’m already ready to cancel. I don’t understand this onboarding flow, it’s needlessly restrictive. First, it takes you to a screen where you’re supposed to select “all categories” but this isn’t clear so I started selecting apps to block and it threw an error. I went back and chose “all categories,” but it’s not clear what the point of this is. Next I’m taken to a screen where it tells me to choose an app to block. Again, I’m given the option to choose multiple so I scroll through and select the ones I want to block. Again, it throws an error and tells I’m supposed to just choose 1 and I can choose more later. Fine, I add one social media app and set limits. I’m then taken to the home screen where I see the option to add additional app limits. I go through and select multiple again, get an error again.

The flow is needlessly long, unnecessarily restrictive, and the lack of an option to select multiple/bulk select is very frustrating.

I have decided to go back to the other screen time app I was using.

Update: I’ve cancelled the free trial and deleted the app

reviews.title: DO NOT SIGN UP FOR THE TRIAL!!!
reviews.text:
Update: After reaching out again after this review, they offered another means to refund. With that out of the way, I can share that I believe this app is worth getting for anyone. Though their trial process needs tweaks, if affordable, I think it’s worth a subscription if reducing screen time is a personal goal. I’m not sure if family plans are offered or not, but this would be an excellent tool to have on many kids’ and adult phones. I like this tool a lot more than apple’s screen time restrictions. It’s a lot easier to click past those Apple messages but with this app I really do appreciate the streak aspect. I really wish I could exclude individual apps from what’s considered screen time instead of app categories though. 

 I signed up for the free trial and for the reminder to be sent at the end for canceling before renewal. The reminder never came and then I was charged $70 for the annual subscription. On the same day, I emailed and appealed to the company and to Apple for a refund and was denied twice. Never have I ever been denied a refund from an app company for not canceling a trial, the app is the exact same as before with no changes or benefits, and this was the most expensive option for subscription. This felt like the biggest scam ever. Though I did sign up for the cancellation/renewal reminder and never got it, it’s partially on me for not just cancelling ahead of time. However, I really don’t like how this company responded and also would not allow for a refun

reviews.title: Hides Payment after already making an account and asking for a review
reviews.text:
Asks for reviews and forces you to make an account before telling you it’s free for 7 days, and £3.99 for a 30 day TRIAL, which means after that it’s even more than that! 

I downloaded this app as part of some research towards what we are doing to combat everyone turning into brain rot individuals with no ability for their own conscious thought, and who are scared of every second of alone time without brains being occupied by something. This is a real problem where people need to come together to bring awareness to it. It’s a shame apps like this are getting wrapped up into more consumerism. They claim to use the same addicting methods aka. A reward system, to get you to pay them so you can stay off your phone. 

What have we done? 

Terrible

reviews.title: Bear trap of a subscription practice
reviews.text: So, I tried it out. The free week trial. It’s basically ScreenZen with a few more features, most helpful for me being pop ups that give you a warning when you’re 30 seconds out from being exited from your apps. The format is nice looking, and it helped me when I was first trying it out, but then I got bored/memorized the features and how to “work around it” and started wondering why I hadn’t gotten a single pop up about my free trial expiring since I knew for a fact I signed up to receive notice as to when my subscription will end. Turns out, two days ago they charged me for the $60 year subscription. No notice. Dude…… don’t be like me. Just stick to screen zen and toss those guys a tip for what they’re doing. It’ll be so much cheaper than attempting to try this, and you might get a good music recommendation out of it. ALSO ALSO. The information BePresent gives on how to cancel your subscription is straight up wrong and doesn’t work. I had to cancel it manually in my iCloud subscriptions, which I don’t think a lot of people would be familiar enough to know/the company purposefully misleads you and will not let you do it from the app. Diabolical honestly, taking advantage of folks seeking help.

reviews.title: Great idea but …
reviews.text: I think the whole idea is great and definitely something I personally need but I found this app so complicated to set up and so restrictive because I could not fully understand the setup - I locked myself out of use - so to prevent it again - I had to cancel the free trial as I find it just too complicated.  Also £39 a year is really too much. I know it’s a price of 1 coffee  per month but it’s just too much.  So it’s a no for me - too complicated and too expensive - great idea though just make it easy so not just programmers can use it

reviews.title: Great concept, needs work
reviews.text:
If the goal is to "focus" and "be present" this app goes overboard. I'm here for the gamification BUT: it only allows you to exclude two app categories, which is absurd because I have 13. I only want INCLUDE two app categories: social media and games. Otherwise, unfortunately our lives are too intertwined with our smartphones and they're necessary to just do regular every day things. I want to block travel, but I need my plane tickets. I want to block education, but I'm trying to learn a new language before an international move. I want to block shopping, but I'm trying to order groceries for the week so I can save an hour shopping at the store and hang out with my family instead. I want to block fitness, but I want to account for my steps after a walk outside with my dogs. I want to block utilities, but for some reason that's where my smart lights and pet feeders are and obviously I need both of those. I can't be fully present if I'm having to go through a screen time blocking app to "give up" or "take a break." It's wasting time I could have spent  being present.

I really hope you guys take this review into account. Make the app more accessible and customizable. It's a great concept, but the Customer Effort Score ain't looking good right now.

reviews.title: wouldn’t bother
reviews.text:
glitchy/broken without fix/broken before even trying it, waste of time & storage really. 
downloaded this app and was asked to subscribe before even signing up essentially, declined at first but just went through with the 2 week free trial when it immediately popped up again. started signing up and have been stuck for days on the same page of which apps youd like to block, ive done one app, two apps, the apps i actually wanted to block, all the apps, every time i confirmed it would pop up with “choose at least 1 app” and couldn’t go forwards, i closed the app and retried more than multiple times, my phone had even died in between trying but nothing worked. eventually gave up and have unsubscribed and deleted the app and will never know whether it would have worked but considering how difficult it was being to set up i doubt it.

reviews.title: I am extremely upset and disappointed
reviews.text:
I composed this message to be sent to bepresents customer service which doesn’t even work. Why even bother to include it in your website if it doesn’t even work? “Hello, I am reaching out to share my disappointment on being charged without being reminded about cancellation on my free trial. Not only has the app not worked the way I intended, but the first time I tried cancelling it. The email you sent the first time to cancel it, did not work. I was lied to twice. First time being that I thought I could cancel it the first day because it didn't work that I thought it would, which is fair. But no notification. No email, no nothing. Seeing I was charged honestly makes me want to cry because I'm already struggling with money as it is. I feel scammed. Please, can we fix something out?” 

Do not get the free trail. You can’t even try it out restricted. You HAVE to buy the free trail. And if you don’t remember you got it or just have a busy life schedule. You will forget about it. And that’s how they get you. They will not send a reminder about it.

reviews.title: Fraudulent Charge/Scam
reviews.text: I did the free trial of this app, after one day I decided that I wouldn’t use the app as intended and canceled the free trial and deleted the app. A few days later I noticed a charge on my bank account for the full cost of the subscription. There is no receipt for this purchase in my Apple account, it does not appear in my subscriptions, or purchase history. Because of this I cannot file a complaint with Apple and multiple attempts to reach out to the app by email (no phone numbers listed) have gone unanswered. I have tried to make contact by the phone number on my bank transaction and that is a company out of Utah that has nothing to do with app. I will now have to file a fraud report with my bank. I believe this app is a scam as they took money out of my account without permission, make it impossible to contact anyone and the help section on the app itself runs you in circles.

reviews.title: Like this app but mad about subscription
reviews.text: I do think that this app can be functional & works if you keep up with it, which I did for the most part while I had it. I can’t say i’m not upset with the subscription options though. When I got it I obviously started with the free trial and then monthly subscription. After my trial was over I went to cancel it because I didn’t feel like it reduced my screen time in the way I wanted it to, but I saw there was another free trial option if I switched to a yearly subscription and I really wanted to give it a try because of the reviews. Unfortunately it charged me for the yearly fee immediately with no free trial & even though I appealed to apple twice for a refund they denied it. So I’m stuck with this app for a year despite the fact that I don’t think I will be using it 😐 really unfortunate.

reviews.title: Good but very glitchy
reviews.text: I like the way this app works to break my habit of automatically opening social media anytime I am on my phone, and to use my limited time more carefully. However the app itself is extremely glitchy and laggy. I am often needing to unblock an app for work reasons, and I spend a lot of time waiting for the app to load the app list, and often needing to reload it as it crashes. I have the most up to date version, but unfortunately I still experience these problems. It’s a shame that a paid for app works like this.

reviews.title: Limitations Render It Impractical & Useless In My Case
reviews.text: It’s a great idea in theory but the way that it categorizes apps means you can’t exclude apps that need to remain running even though i’m not “using my phone.” For example when my security camera notifies me in the night of an alert, i can’t be opening the Present app and then checking the security footage. I also need my daughter’s baby monitor app for when i get notifications in the night, but that is classified as a different category and the app only lets you exclude two categories, which basically renders the app useless for me. Those are just two examples, but I actually have about six apps that I need even when I phone in an unproductive way. I realize restriction is helpful for an app like this, but there needs to be a little bit more customization if people are actually gonna be able to use it in this day and age IMO.

reviews.title: It doesn’t calculate the time correctly
reviews.text:
I don’t understand how the time is being calculated. I just got a notification that I am coming close to 14! hours of screen time today It’s only 8 am, this day didn’t even have 14 hours yet. And I was sleeping through majority of today’s hours, so how is that possible? I get sometimes notification at 12:30 am that my screen time is 2 hours already. How?
I also don’t appreciate that it counts screen time when I play music in my car. I don’t even touch the phone, it is not lit up. When I drive somewhere and I have a GPS, it counts it as a screen time. Even though it is displayed on my car screen, not my phone. I use GPS all the time even when I know where I am going, because it warns me about bad traffic ahead, so I am getting ridiculously high screen time because of that.

reviews.title: Incredibly glitchy
reviews.text:
I want to start off by saying that this app did help me at first, mostly because it has notifications when I’m approaching a certain amount of time on my phone which helps break me out of my trance with doom scrolling. With that being said, there will be random days where all of a sudden I just get a bunch of push notifications all at once, and then I go to the app and find out that they aren’t even accurate. It will also send me push notifications that I’ve completed a focus mode when I turned off that focus mode. I’ve done everything the app suggests such as having screen time only for this device. It also will randomly glitch so I can’t exit whatever “focus” mode it’s put on, so I’m just stuck out of apps that I need (ie travel, need my boarding pass). Overall, I’m glad I tried the app but I’m deleting it because these have gotten too annoying.
One other thing: I cancelled my recurring subscription (paid for the whole year) six months early but rather than getting the benefits of the subscription that I paid for until June, they cancelled them already. It’s January.

reviews.title: Frustrating & fails to deliver
reviews.text: The app does not allow you to choose certain sections and numerous apps & the times etc I want to use it. It’s very limited & difficult to use. I’m really disappointed to have paid for an app that really isn’t fit for purpose your saying it’s for . Even after the trail and paying it doesn’t do what it’s advertising. It also said it would remind you to cancel the subscription but yet another company that fails in this area as non reminder. So I’ve paid for an app that doesn’t work & it doesn’t even have the ability to do what it says. Doubt I’ll see my £40 again as per other reviews so an absolute waste of money. Avoid this app as it’s useless

reviews.title: Should be better for the price you pay
reviews.text:
Good basic app blocker and is effective but it’s quite clunky and has loads of teething problems especially with the customisation aspect of things:
- you cannot re-order your blocking sessions chronologically so it stays forever in the order that you added the sessions in unless you delete and re-add everything again
- app often glitches/freezes and crashes when modifying blocked/allowed apps (even after I disabled Screen Time apps/time limits on my iPhone)
- it continues to track time if an app is left running in the background so not really accurate and you are limited as you can only have one or two ‘allowed’ app categories that will not affect the time tracked.
- leaderboard doesn’t extend beyond diamond trophy so you just stay indefinitely on diamond for all eternity which takes away the gamification appeal of app blocking 
- also you can accumulate points but the rewards do not change which is a little boring 
- quite pricy at £20 annual subscription for what you get 
- lacks a pomodoro-type timer that you can simply hit to start a productive session

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: Three problems: #1 It doesn’t block websites in phone browsers even though there is a screen that says it does (I confirmed this with their customer support twice because it seems really mislabeled and a bit of false advertising).  So you can block the Facebook app but not the Facebook website.  #2 The search function is buggy and the screen resets frequently while you’re trying to allow or block apps so you have to search 2-3 times each time to add or remove an app #3 The app overlays with Apple’s native screen control functions with some additional features and design. But it takes a lot of set up.  This app blocks everything by default during “quiet” hours which becomes an exercise in repeatedly unblocking apps that you aren’t addicted to and just need to use for a second (weather, thermostat, bank, etc)…it gets frustrating.
